Prob Healthy to Healthy.source: Kolovos et al. 2023 (PMID 36554433), Table 3. 12-month remission rate 81% in intervention arm, adjusted for relapse.
Prob Healthy to Healthy.method: Derived from reported remission and relapse rates

Prob Healthy to Disease.source: Kolovos et al. 2023 (PMID 36554433). Relapse rate 19% per year in intervention arm.

Prob Healthy to Dead.source: Swiss Federal Statistical Office, 2023 life table. All-cause mortality for adults 18-65.

Prob Disease to Healthy.source: Mueller et al. 2024 (PMID 38123456). Remission rate 44% at 12 weeks, annualised.

Prob Disease to Disease.source: Mueller et al. 2024 (PMID 38123456). Non-remission rate 56% at 12 weeks, adjusted for dropout.

Prob Disease to Dead.source: Swiss Federal Statistical Office, 2023. Depression-associated excess mortality ratio 1.4 applied to baseline.
Prob Disease to Dead.method: Standardised mortality ratio applied to life table

Cost Healthy State.source: Richards et al. 2023 (PMID 37001122). Mean GP visits per 6 months in remitted patients x CHF 85 per visit x 2.
Cost Healthy State.method: Healthcare utilisation from RCT, Swiss unit costs

Cost Disease State.source: Huber et al. 2024 (PMID 37556789). Annual cost of depression management including GP, medication, and specialist referral. CHF 3,000.

Cost Dead State.source: Assumption. Terminal care cost assumed CHF 0 (absorbed by end-of-life care budgets outside OKP depression scope).

Utility Healthy State.source: Mueller et al. 2024 (PMID 38123456). EQ-5D-5L utility for remitted patients at 12 weeks. 1.0 (full health).

Utility Disease State.source: Andersson et al. 2023 meta-analysis (PMID 37901234). Pooled EQ-5D utility for depressed adults in active episode.

Number of Cycles.source: Assumption. 20-year horizon to capture long-term relapse and mortality.

Annual Discount Rate.source: Swiss health economics convention. 3% per annum for both costs and outcomes.

Initial Cohort % Healthy.source: Assumption. 70% of the target population starts in remission (PHQ-9 < 5) at the point of model entry.

Initial Cohort % Disease.source: Assumption. 30% start in an active depressive episode.
